rules: Every listed source is a draft source proposal, not a production or Android screenshot
Selected entry merely establishes an ordered human-review candidate, not a frozen owner choice
Contradictory alternative sources remain findable in the exhaustive atlas, not silently promoted
Separate source illustration from independent raster inspection, Android runtime, accessibility and owner approval
Confirm all features on 24 core surfaces, 34 support variants, 23 connected journeys and 56 audit scenarios before whole-set freeze
Do not approve generic original plates that the latest R01–R08 photographic/audit proposal has visibly superseded
No second reel is chosen merely to decorate a page; Home crescent remains an explicit human comparison question

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Home photographic crescent
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Keep a clearly labeled, tap-only crescent collection cover or use a conventional card?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Finite photographic reel
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Do physical five-aperture paper rim, zoom, pointer, hero and clipped wheel communicate a usable photo selector?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Action hierarchy
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: At normal and 200% text, do Grid, Next/Previous, Set wallpaper and external sharing appear understandable and sufficiently accessible?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Selected vs applied
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Is app-acknowledged Home p04 clearly distinguished from selected p12 and unknown current system wallpaper?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Provider lifetime
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Are locally verified images and pending Google Photos source items correctly represented under offline/revoked/low-storage conditions?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: OS-owned UI and background claims
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Are system picker/sharesheet/Lock availability and best-effort five-minute scheduling portrayed without inventing guaranteed results?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Restore consequences
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Are preview, Skip/Keep/Separate, committed outcome and Back clearly separate and safely reversible?

explicitOwnerQuestions.subject: Whole-product visual language
explicitOwnerQuestions.decision: Do support, recovery, accessibility and native entry points feel like the same Glimpse product as the photographic paper reel?
